title: fathom
pitch: submarine duel against a computer with opinions. every miss tells you how close you were. decoys lie.
controls: tap or click the enemy sea to fire. arrow keys + enter also fire, s toggles sonar. drag subs to move, tap to rotate. modes: classic or salvo.
changelog: v2.3.1: medals paced for day 2 and 3: about 4-5 in a first session (sink a sub, win, beat screensaver, finish a daily...), then dailies on 2 days, a 3-day daily streak, root, salvo and 10 wins; one dive gives at most 2. v2.3: a career between dives: a rank from your wins (deckhand to root of the sea), 12 medals with the next one always on the title and the end card (tap it to set up that dive) and the one still winnable shown under the boards during a dive, a daily streak, a rank-up / medal moment on the board. the site's results card waits behind the bar instead of covering the game's own end card; restart and play again start a new dive; hub tap-to-play skips the title; a resumed daily now reaches the site; a faster hunt breaks score ties and a loss never scores 0. v2.2: in short player frames the rival talks from the top bar instead of covering the enemy-sea label. v2.1: bigger boards in short and landscape phone frames, score and per-mode best on the end card (and how many hits a loss was from a win), best on the title, daily trail wraps instead of spilling off the card. v2: three rivals with voices (dial-up, screensaver, root), salvo mode (one shot per surviving sub), spoiler-free daily share, forfeit counts as a loss (with confirm), enter-key and card fixes.
